scenes.setting: City of Silver: Derrick nerves himself to climb the spire and report Darc's stranger's smile and Lovia's changed speech — but the guard waves him straight up, the Chief only says Aiflor will investigate and to report to the spire's guardian in future; Colin sighs at his back, disappointed

Home via metro and public carriage: divination confirms the old tenant told the truth, another late night with the Book of Secrets ('What limits me now is my own Sequence'), and a sound sleep rewarded with sugared egg and strawberry jam
scenes.text_anchor: To reward the Hero Bandit Dark Emperor

scenes.setting: An early doorbell brings a pale Dr. Aaron with a nightmare: a black steeple ringed by a huge silver snake, walls and locked doors, and Will Auceptin curled in the dark among tarot cards — 'a snake wants to eat me!' — and the paper crane the boy gave him, retrieved into his wallet that very evening
scenes.text_anchor: “Dr. Aaron, a snake wants to eat me!’
